stories.title: From learning to leaderboard: How Cisco upskilled 1,200 engineers in agentic AI with AWS AI League

This post shares Cisco's journey, lessons from the 2026 winning agent built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and how to host your own league.

stories.title: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI
stories.summary: Cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI gives your application one invocation path across the endpoints and inference components you already run, in one or more AWS Regions and AWS accounts. The router prefers its own Region and shifts new requests to another destination only when the local one can't serve reliably.

stories.title: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
stories.summary: Learn how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call. Added as a gateway interceptor, Skyflow de-identifies data before any tool, model, or log sees it, and restores it for authorized callers, with no change to your agent code.

stories.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart

stories.title: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS
